_note: Human-readable registry only. Not parsed by Claude Code. Functional MCP config lives in .mcp.json files inside each plugin.

servers.name: context7
servers.description: Up-to-date documentation for any library or framework, fetched live from official sources. Prevents hallucinated APIs.

servers.name: figma
servers.description: Access Figma files, components, and design tokens directly. Implement designs in any framework in one shot.
servers.command: claude mcp add --transport http figma https://mcp.figma.com/mcp

servers.name: github
servers.description: Access GitHub repositories, issues, and pull requests. Implement features from issues and open PRs directly.
servers.auth: PAT via Bearer header — run the github-authentication skill to generate and store GITHUB_TOKEN
servers.command: claude mcp add --transport http github https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ --header "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}"

servers.name: gtm
servers.description: Google Tag Manager - read containers, tags, triggers and variables. Used by tracking-plan to confirm which events have a GA4 tag and to validate parameter names against declared Data Layer variables.
servers.auth: OAuth (Google account - browser flow on first use)
servers.command: claude mcp add -t http gtm https://mcp.gtmeditor.com

servers.name: playwright
servers.description: Browser automation: navigate, click, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data from live pages.
